summary: Your colour reaches the real app window, and marks follow a Page Down

groups.title: Your colour
items: Your colour now reaches the real app window: the title bar, the side bar, the Check button, the tray and the taskbar.
The delicate-scan digits follow your colour.

groups.title: The website
items: The phone bottom bar keeps its icons and names on one line.
The hero name no longer slides when fonts arrive.
Blueprint labels stay off the words at Larger text.

groups.title: Search results and updates
items: Marks follow a Page Down after the page has been quiet.
If an update's leftover installer is still busy, the downloaded update is cleared again shortly after instead of being left behind.

groups.title: Behind the scenes
items: A new check photographs the real app window in five colours.
Detection is now also scored with no list loaded, with a fingerprint of the verdicts and the list snapshot dates, so releases compare.
A flaky colour check and the honest-sites check were made steady at their causes.
